August 4, 2024

To Whom It May Concern,

This letter pertains to Mr. Michael Ortega, who I have been following for his Coronary artery disease, status post PCI/stent. He was seen today for a routine follow-up.

On this visit, Mr. Ortega reported no new cardiac symptoms. His blood pressure was 140/65 and his weight was 130 pounds. He continues on his medications which include atorvastatin 10 mg, aspirin 81 mg, and metoprolol 25 mg. His ejection fraction stable at 58%, and he continues to do well post-stent placement with no reported angina. The most recent lipid panel showed an LDL of 60 mg/dL.

In 2010, an outside lab report from Heritage Diagnostic Services showed a fructosamine level of 222, cholesterol/HDL ratio of 257/43, negative cotinine, and a gamma GT of 23. These values have remained consistent with his current status.

Mr. Ortega has a family history of type 2 diabetes in his mother, who was diagnosed at the age of 71. However, he himself does not report any diabetic symptoms and his current medications do not include any diabetic treatments.

Thank you for your attention to these matters.

Sincerely, 
Dr. Debra Harrington 
White-Brewer Clinic
